title: uruguayan jerusalem artichokes gratin
description: a nutrient-rich, savory uruguayan gratin dish featuring roasted jerusalem artichokes and a nut-free crust.

ingredients.name: leeks
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, white and light green parts only

instructions: in a large saucepan, combine the sliced jerusalem artichokes, leeks, and garlic. Add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned, about 20 minutes.
in a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to prevent lumps. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until it thickens, about 5 minutes.
remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
in a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
add the cooked jerusalem artichoke mixture and the cheese sauce to the bowl with the eggs and stir until well combined.
transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and smooth the top.
dot the top of the gratin with the butter.
bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
